_comment: Admin-only model overlay. Applied to the ADMIN role config override by
Endpoints listed here are visible AND usable by ADMIN users only. Non-admins
never receive them in their resolved config, so the models are absent from the
model selector and rejected by the server if requested directly.
To gate a newly released model: add its id to models.default below, then run
To promote it to everyone: add the id to ANTHROPIC_MODELS in .env, remove it
'custom' entries merge by 'name', so this appends to librechat.yaml's list
(OpenRouter) rather than replacing it. Keep names stable across applies.

custom._note: CONFIRM THE MODEL ID before applying - 'gpt-astra' is a placeholder. Use the exact id OpenAI's /v1/models returns, or the request will be rejected upstream.
